hero.title: Learn to code
hero.text: Python, JavaScript and web development courses with short lessons and exercises that are checked instantly. And what you earn while learning is used in a world you play in with other people.
hero.note: The first lesson of every course works without an account.
hero.worldAlt: Modern house built from blocks in the CodeBuddies isometric world
hero.exerciseAlt: Real course exercise: the code is typed, Check is pressed and Buddy the robot responds
hero.worldCaption: What you earn, in your world
hero.exerciseCaption: Real exercise: you write, you check, Buddy responds

courses.title: Explore what you can learn
courses.text: Complete courses that take you from zero to real projects, with step-by-step explanations and exercises that check themselves.
courses.empty: We could not load the courses right now.

paths.title: Choose where to start
paths.text: Never written code? Start from zero. Already know the basics? Go straight to the professional track.

EASY.title: From zero
EASY.text: For people who have never coded. Step by step, in plain words.

MEDIUM.title: Professional track
MEDIUM.text: For people who want to work building websites and web apps.

HARD.title: Advanced
HARD.text: For people who already code and want to go further.

read.title: Get the idea
read.text: A short explanation with examples before you touch the code.

write.title: Write real code
write.text: Right in the browser editor. Nothing to install.

check.title: Instant feedback
check.text: You know right away if it works, and you earn XP and coins.

game.title: A world you build yourself
game.text: CodeBuddies comes with a built-in isometric game. What you earn while learning is used here: build with blocks, decorate your room and share it with your friends.
game.screenAlt: The avatar walks around a castle built by a player; on the left, their level, XP and coins
game.nightAlt: A modern house goes from day to night and its lanterns light up
game.pcAlt: The room PC opens and, inside it, CodeStudio with the Pixel Pizza startup
game.nightCaption: At night, the lights come on
game.pcCaption: Your room has a PC: that is where CodeStudio lives

build.title: Build block by block
build.text: Houses, castles or anything you imagine, with pieces you stack and paint.

avatar.title: Your avatar, your style
avatar.text: A wardrobe with clothes, hair and colors.

rooms.title: Rooms with friends
rooms.text: Visit public rooms, chat and invite anyone you want.

shop.title: Shop and pet
shop.text: Buy items with the coins you earn in lessons.

game.buildAlt: A modern house appearing block by block in the game world
game.screenCaption: Walk your world with your level, XP and coins in view

studio.title: From learning concepts to founding your startup
studio.text: Inside the game there is a simulator: pick the app you want to build, ship its features, hire your team, fix bugs and compete in the global ranking.

tree.title: Product tree
tree.text: Landing page, sign-up, payments, SEO, tests: each feature unlocks in order, just like a real product.

team.title: Your team
team.text: Hire junior, mid and senior profiles. Team chemistry changes performance.

ops.title: Bugs, servers and marketing
ops.text: When the app grows, servers get overloaded and bugs show up. You decide how to fix it.

studio.clipAlt: In CodeStudio the Pixel Pizza startup is founded, the product tree appears and the first feature opens
studio.clipCaption: Real capture: founding a startup and picking its first feature

progress.title: Everything you do counts
progress.text: Lessons, missions and CodeStudio all raise the same level.

missions.label: Missions
missions.text: Daily and weekly missions with extra XP and coins.
missions.alt: Missions page with the daily CodeStudio missions

pass.label: Season pass
pass.text: Come in every day and unlock rewards. Miss a day and you continue where you left off.
pass.alt: Season pass with the reward for each day

achievements.label: Achievements
achievements.text: One for every milestone: your first startup, your first fixed bug, your first employee.
achievements.alt: Unlocked achievements with their XP and coins

progress.more: There are also rankings, badges and a certificate when you finish a course.

final.title: Your first line of code is one click away
final.text: Do the first lesson without an account. If you like it, save your progress and enter the world.
